source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Taking the place of the ongoing clinical follow-up visits the client would otherwise still need to attend","B":"Help detect potential cancer recurrence, ideally at an earlier, more treatable stage, per an individualized surveillance schedule","C":"Carrying fairly little clinical purpose at all once a client's cancer treatment has been completed","D":"Applying mainly to clients who had the most advanced cancer at initial diagnosis, rather than to survivors broadly"}}
source_row.rationale: Scheduled surveillance imaging after cancer treatment completion is intended to help detect potential cancer recurrence, ideally at an earlier, more treatable stage, following an individualized surveillance schedule based on the specific cancer type and initial stage, complementing (not replacing) ongoing clinical follow-up.
